result:
Posts can now be scheduled to publish later. `bunx guren gate` passes all six stages (codegen, typecheck, lint, check, audit and tests), including 6 new tests. I also ran `bun run console posts:scheduled` against the test database: stdout was exactly one tab-separated line and it exited with 0. Nothing is committed.

- **Storage:** a nullable `published_at` text column on `posts`, with a migration that adds it.
- **Form field:** `publishAt` is accepted on create and edit. It must look like a date and time (for example `2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z`); anything else, such as `next tuesday`, gets the same 422 as an empty title and nothing is saved. Valid values are stored in the same UTC format as `created_at`.
- **Visibility:** everywhere, a post counts as public when `published_at` is empty or not later than now. It is checked when each request runs, so nothing has to happen when the time passes. The list, search and home page show public posts plus the signed-in user's own scheduled ones. A scheduled post's page returns the same 404 as a missing post to anyone but its author.
- **Report:** `posts:scheduled` prints `id<TAB>title<TAB>published_at`, soonest first, and nothing else on stdout.

Three behaviours you might not expect:
- **Editing without the field clears the date.** The contract says an absent `publishAt` means "publish now", so an edit that leaves it out makes a scheduled post public straight away.
- **The home page never shows scheduled posts**, not even to their author.
- **Stored dates are compared as text.** Values the app writes always compare correctly. A date written straight into the database in a different format, such as with a `+09:00` offset, could be judged wrongly.

The main changes are in `db/schema.ts`, the new migration under `db/migrations/`, `app/Models/Post.ts` (new `visibleTo`, `isVisibleTo` and `isScheduled` helpers), `app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts` (`publishedAt` is now on every post), `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` (list, search and page are filtered, and create and edit save the date) and `app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.ts`. The report command is `app/Console/Commands/ListScheduledPostsCommand.ts`, registered in `src/console.ts`. The New and Edit pages have a "Publish at" field, which the browser converts to UTC before sending. The Index and Show pages mark scheduled posts with the date they go live. The tests are in `tests/ScheduledPosts.test.ts`.
